trust_decision.summary: Untrusted agent-supplied action/expression arguments cross into the browser navigation API; the decision is made in the basic-catalog openUrl function implementation, which must resolve the URL and allowlist http/https before calling window.open.

landing_point.why: The advisory names openUrl, and the only openUrl implementation in the repo is OpenUrlImplementation, which passes args.url straight to window.open.

fix_sites.entry_point: openUrl basic-catalog function (OpenUrlImplementation / BASIC_FUNCTIONS, exported from @a2ui/web_core/v0_9/basic_catalog), invoked from a component Action's functionCall or any expression argument

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate navigation must keep working: window.open resolves relative URLs ('/relative-path', 'relative/nested/path', '../parent-path', '?tab=profile') against the page URL, and plain http:// (not only https) is a valid scheme; a prefix allowlist or an https-only check silently breaks those, and the URL normalization the fix introduces also changes exact strings (e.g. 'https://example.com' becomes 'https://example.com/').

O6_input_shapes: absolute https URL (with path, port, query)
data:, vbscript:, file:, chrome:, about: schemes
missing/undefined url (still a silent no-op, not an error)
non-string url JSON value coerced to a string by the OpenUrlApi zod schema before the implementation runs

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An additional catalog function such as openExternal/navigate for platform deep-linking that also calls window.open or window.location.assign with an agent-supplied URL.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The spec describes openUrl as 'opening in the system browser or deep-linking to an app', so a maintainer could add a second, platform-specific opener to createBasicCatalogFunctions without reusing the scheme check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A renderer-local function implementation list that defines its own openUrl-style function instead of importing BASIC_FUNCTIONS.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Each renderer assembles its own catalog (Lit, React and Angular all pass BASIC_FUNCTIONS through a per-renderer catalog object), so a maintainer adding a custom opener per renderer is a normal change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A React-specific wrapper that opens links for a component (e.g. a Card/Button link prop) via window.open, bypassing the catalog function.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The React v0_8 tree already renders markdown links with real hrefs, so a component-level link opener is plausible in the same package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A markdown/link renderer path where an agent-supplied URL is emitted into an anchor href without scheme validation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The markdown package is the HTML sink for Text content and only sanitizes when DOMPurify has a window, so a parallel javascript:-URL sink could grow here.

O9_family: DOM-based cross-site scripting via unvalidated URL scheme (CWE-79)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js; Yarn 4.13.0 workspaces (package.json:4); wireit + tsc 5.9.3 for build; node --test for tests
O10_build.project_tests: renderers/web_core/src/v0_9/basic_catalog/functions/basic_functions.test.ts (node:test + node:assert; the openUrl case stubs global.window.open, lines 470-489)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Prepend a denylist check such as `if (String(args.url).startsWith('javascript:')) return;` (or a small regex denylist) before window.open, keeping the raw string; this misses whitespace-prefixed, 'javascript://%0A', data:, vbscript:, file:, chrome: and about: forms and leaves the URL unresolved.

out_of_scope_notes: agent_sdks/python/a2ui_core/src/a2ui/core/basic_catalog/function_impls.py:342-344 implements openUrl as a deliberate no-op with no navigation sink, so the absent scheme check there is not exploitable — not pursued.
renderers/markdown/markdown-it already sanitizes javascript: markdown links via DOMPurify (a different sink from openUrl) — not pursued.

samples/community/client/lit/personalized_learning/src/a2ui-renderer.ts:94-101 interpolates a source URL into an anchor href, but the value comes from the hosting app's SourceInfo rather than the agent — not pursued.
